integrity: The full infinite family is justified by explicit combinatorial constructions and the window-sum continuity argument; finite direct checks are supplemental only. Scientific provenance is supplied in references. No independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact length-three binary unordered noiseless composition-read multispectra only. Read-length-four-and-higher counterexamples do not amount to a complete wide-window profile classification. The identical cubic counting polynomial already appears in OEIS A188554 for a different object and is not claimed numerically novel. Other equivalent realizability specializations might exist.
title: Interval-support characterization for binary three-window composition multispectra and the sharp four-window obstruction
